steps.message:
FILES: fastapi/openapi/utils.py:380-406
CAUSE: `additional_response.copy()` is a shallow copy. When `additional_response` contains a `content` dictionary, `process_response['content']` shares the same object across all routes. `deep_dict_update` then appends the schema (e.g., `anyOf` lists) to this shared dictionary repeatedly for every route.
FIX: Use `copy.deepcopy(additional_response)` instead of `additional_response.copy()` to ensure each route has its own independent copy of the response configuration.

steps.message:
The issue was caused by a shallow copy of the `additional_response` dictionary in `fastapi/openapi/utils.py`, which led to shared state across routes when `content` was specified. Replacing `additional_response.copy()` with `copy.deepcopy(additional_response)` ensures each route has its own independent response configuration, preventing the accumulation of duplicate `$ref` entries in the `anyOf` array of the OpenAPI schema.

The fix has been verified as GREEN.
